checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: One square finished image is delivered
Headline reads exactly “Small cup. Big energy.”
must.why: Text reads exactly, with both periods.
White bold text on dark background, fully inside the frame.

must.item: Steaming espresso on sunlit café table
must.why: Espresso cup with crema and faint steam, sunlight and shadows on table. Café setting is minimal but acceptable.

faults.what: Steam is faint, and the café context is not obvious since the background is blurred and plain.

summary: A clean, warm square image of a steaming espresso in sunlight with the exact, readable headline and no extra text; steam is subtle and the café setting is minimal.
